title: LLM Serving Lab
summary: A reproducible systems lab for studying large-language-model inference serving and performance behavior on a single RTX 4090 24 GB GPU.
summary_zh: 面向单卡 RTX 4090 24 GB 环境的大模型推理服务实验平台，用于构建可复现的系统实验与性能分析流程。
highlights: Building a vLLM-based benchmark workflow for TTFT, TPOT, throughput and concurrent serving.
Planning controlled studies of KV Cache behavior and serving configurations; no benchmark result is claimed yet.
highlights_zh: 基于 vLLM 搭建 TTFT、TPOT、吞吐量与并发服务的 Benchmark 流程。
规划 KV Cache 行为及服务配置的对照实验；项目尚在建设中，暂不宣称任何性能结论。

title: HaiXin Edge AI
category_zh: 端侧 AI 与软硬件协同
summary: An edge-AI inference acceleration project built around an FPGA, a RISC-V processor and a tensor engine.
summary_zh: 围绕 FPGA、RISC-V 处理器与 Tensor Engine 开展的端侧 AI 推理加速项目。
highlights: Adapted convolution, depthwise convolution and pooling operators for the target inference stack.
Participated in preprocessing, postprocessing, deployment debugging and hardware-software integration.
highlights_zh: 参与卷积、深度卷积与池化算子适配，衔接模型算子与目标推理链路。
参与预处理、后处理、部署调试及软硬件联调，推进端侧推理加速落地。

title: Ship Speed Optimization
summary: A machine-learning system for vessel fuel-consumption prediction and multi-objective speed optimization using fused operational data.
summary_zh: 面向船舶油耗预测与多目标航速优化的机器学习系统，融合多源航行数据并提供 Web 端应用。
highlights: Built a LightGBM-based fuel-consumption prediction pipeline with multi-source data fusion.
Developed a Flask and Vue application to connect model inference with optimization workflows.
highlights_zh: 基于 LightGBM 构建油耗预测流程，并完成多源数据融合。
使用 Flask 与 Vue 开发系统，将模型推理与多目标优化流程连接起来。
